purpose: Define the machine-checked contract-hygiene surface that keeps taxonomy, scenarios, review gates, review-head guards, review-separation receipts, and example/schema pairs synchronized after the portable Cargo Report Kit meanings were frozen.

checks.description: The machine-readable Cargo-report control surfaces must agree on the current revision stamp.
Every scenario named in the scenario index must exist on disk and include the required scenario files.
Scenario coverage values must come from the taxonomy register rather than silently minted strings.
Review gates may only refer to schema-backed artifact families or declared control surfaces.
Every example JSON must validate against its intended schema before a revision touching the fixture spine is treated as complete.
Manual-review carries should only appear through schema-backed review requests and decision witnesses, with scenario coverage showing both pending and resolved states.
Review-head guard semantics must stay schema-backed and scenario-covered so stale-head review cannot silently carry onto newer heads.
Manual-review carries that claim stronger reuse must include review-separation refs, and scenario coverage must include both independent-checker and self-review-hold paths.
